root.label: std::filesystem
root.note: Path is text; the other functions ask an OS that others may change at any time.

children.label: Path as a value
children.note: A path holds a string and splits it by lexical rules.

children.label: Generic vs native
children.note: Generic uses forward slashes; native is the platform's own form, and on POSIX they match.

children.label: Decomposition
children.note: stem and extension split at the last dot; a leading dot is not an extension.

children.label: Trailing separator
children.note: a/b/ iterates as a, b and an empty element, and its filename() is empty.

children.label: Comparison
children.note: Elementwise: a//b equals a/b, but a trailing slash or a dot element differs.

children.label: Joining paths
children.note: operator/ is append, not string concatenation.

children.label: Absolute right side
children.note: An absolute right-hand path replaces the left side entirely.

children.label: Empty right side
children.note: path("a") / "" gives a/ with a trailing separator.

children.label: operator+=
children.note: Plain concatenation with no separator inserted.

children.label: Lexical vs real
children.note: Text functions never touch the disk; resolving functions do.

children.label: lexically_normal
children.note: Cancels dot and name/.. as text and yields . when the result is empty.

children.label: canonical
children.note: Resolves symlinks and requires the path to exist.

children.label: weakly_canonical
children.note: Resolves the existing prefix and normalizes the rest textually.

children.label: link/.. trap
children.note: The OS follows link first, so link/.. differs from the lexical result.

children.label: Errors and status
children.note: Two overload families and symlink-aware queries.

children.label: Throwing overload
children.note: Throws filesystem_error carrying the code and the paths.

children.label: error_code overload
children.note: Reports through the argument, with a sentinel return such as uintmax_t(-1).

children.label: status vs symlink_status
children.note: status follows links; exists is false for a dangling symlink.

children.label: Iteration and operations
children.note: Directory walks and bulk operations depend on options.

children.label: directory_iterator
children.note: Unspecified order; skips . and ..

children.label: recursive iterator
children.note: Does not follow directory symlinks unless follow_directory_symlink is set.

children.label: copy_options
children.note: copy_file fails on an existing target unless skip, overwrite or update is chosen.

children.label: space
children.note: Reports capacity, free and available; available can be less than free.

children.label: Races, time, encoding
children.note: The disk is shared and the types have platform-specific parts.

children.label: File system races
children.note: The standard makes calls that introduce a race undefined; avoid check-then-act.

children.label: file_time_type
children.note: Uses file_clock since C++20; convert with clock_cast to system_clock.

children.label: u8string in C++20
children.note: Returns std::u8string, which does not convert to std::string; u8path is deprecated.
